# crosswork_collection_jobs (Data Source)

This data source can read a bulk collection job of Crosswork by its application id and context id, with its status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_collection_jobs" "example" {
  application_id = "cwtest-app"
  context_id     = "cwtest-context"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Application id of the job, which with the context id identifies it
- `context_id` (String) Context id of the job, unique within the application id

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `cli_sensors` (Attributes List) CLI commands the job runs on the devices (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cli_sensors))
- `collector_type` (String) Collector type of the job, `CLI` or `SNMP` for a job this provider can create; another type is shown as the controller names it
- `destination` (String) Name of the data destination that receives the output
- `device_tag` (String) Tag whose devices the job collects from
- `devices` (Set of String) Inventory ids of the devices the job collects from
- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `life_cycle_state` (String) Life cycle state of the job, for example `SUCCESS_LIFE_CYCLE_STATE`
- `phase` (String) Phase of the job, for example `ACTIVE`
- `snmp_sensors` (Attributes List) SNMP objects the job collects from the devices (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snmp_sensors))
- `status` (String) Status of the job, for example `READY`

<a id="nestedatt--cli_sensors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cli_sensors`

Read-Only:

- `cadence` (Number) Seconds between two runs of the command
- `command` (String) CLI command to run
- `topic` (String) Topic the output of the command is sent to on the destination


<a id="nestedatt--snmp_sensors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snmp_sensors`

Read-Only:

- `cadence` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the OID
- `oid` (String) OID to collect
- `operation` (String) SNMP operation
- `topic` (String) Topic the output of the object is sent to on the destination
